
	<div class="postTitle">
		<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/strick/p/19143599" title="发布于 2025-10-27 10:34">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Web优化躬行记（7）——后台上传大批量图优化</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>　　管理后台基于 <span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)"><a href="https://pro.ant.design/zh-CN/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)">Ant Design Pro</span></a></span> 搭建，组件库是 <span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)"><a href="https://ant-design.antgroup.com/components/overview-cn" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)">Ant Design 5.20</span></a></span>，本文会对糟糕的性能和用户体验进行多轮优化。</p>
<h1>一、存在的问题</h1>
<p>　　核心就是上传的图像数量庞大，公司的网络速度慢，被全国94%的网络用户超越。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015152222698-1049651768.jpg" alt="1" width="800" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>1）预览图显示慢</strong></span></p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015152300301-1053195387.png" alt="2" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015152334317-1472397678.png" alt="3" width="800" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>2）图像请求失败</strong></span></p>
<p>　　上传组件预览图请求失败图裂。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015152402511-1574900260.png" alt="4" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　点击上传组件中的预览按钮，在大图预览时的可拖动区域的小图，也会请求失败图裂</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015152503779-1729008971.png" alt="5" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>3）上传时间长</strong></span></p>
<p>　　上传时间长，页面意外关闭需重新上传。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015152546283-1923726984.png" alt="6" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　接下来会记录优化的整个过程，其中不乏一些失败的优化手段，我都做了一一记录。</p>
<p>　　性能优化的核心是降低图像尺寸，分批次请求等，体验优化的核心是增加反馈交互，续传文件等。</p>
<h1>二、预览小图优化</h1>
<p>　　首先让运营做了一个人工的前置优化。</p>
<p>　　原始图先让摄影师自行压缩一遍，从 4.5M 压缩到 1.5M，总容量从 2.19G 缩小到 466M。</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>1）质量变换</strong></span></p>
<p>　　为预览小图增加<span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)"><a href="https://developer.qiniu.com/dora/8259/the-quality-of-transformation" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)">质量变换</span></a></span>（公司购买了七牛云的服务），经过调试，选择 3p 的图片质量。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">static.xxx.com/activity/review/1746525272362kzrjtd.jpg</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015153021368-715094366.png" alt="7" width="800" loading="lazy"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">static.xxx.com/activity/review/1746525272362kzrjtd.jpg?imageMogr2/thumbnail/!5p</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015153058532-1839533594.png" alt="8" width="800" loading="lazy"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">static.xxx.com/activity/review/1746525272362kzrjtd.jpg?imageMogr2/thumbnail/!3p</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015153125551-2040547766.png" alt="9" width="800" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　三次请求的图像尺寸缩小了 538 倍，请求效率提升了不少。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015153147613-1726480070.png" alt="10" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>2）批量预请求</strong></span></p>
<p>　　另一个优化举措是在上传之前先用脚本批量（10个一组）去请求压缩裁剪后的图。</p>
<p>　　在全部请求完成后才呈现上传区域。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>useEffect(() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 预加载图像</span>
  const imageLoader = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BatchImageLoader({ batchSize: 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
  const imageUrls </span>= current.reviews ? current.reviews.map(url =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scaleImg(url)) : [];
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 批量加载</span>
  imageUrls.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> imageLoader.loadImagesBatch(imageUrls)
      .then((results: ImageLoadResult[]) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        setImgLoading(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 关闭加载中的状态</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      })
      .</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span>((error: Error) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        console.error(</span>'批量加载失败:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error);
  });
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    imageLoader.clearPendingRequests(); </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">销毁请求</span>
    setImgLoading(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 开启加载中的状态</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  }
}, [current])</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015153317769-1801606947.png" alt="11" width="800" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>3）骨架屏</strong></span></p>
<p>　　还给 Modal 组件赋值 loading 属性（5.18.0新增），出现骨架屏效果。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015153358634-1653473677.png" alt="12" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　不过，在骨架屏消失后，本来以为预请求了一次，不会再访问出错，结果还是会有一定概率出错。</p>
<p>　　公司网络比较慢，很容易复现此类问题。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015152402511-1574900260.png" alt="4" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>4）3次重复请求</strong></span></p>
<p>　　并且从上传区域的预加载，到加载组件内的预览图，再到拖动区域的小图，总共进行了 3 次请求，太冗余。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015153453817-517283302.png" alt="14" width="800" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　上述优化，除了质量参数达到了优化的效果，其余没有达到预期，遂放弃。</p>
<h1>三、自定义上传列表项</h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>1）懒加载</strong></span></p>
<p>　　Upload 组件的默认行为，是会加载组件内的所有预览图，所以需要自定义上传列表项（itemRender），做懒加载优化。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const itemRender =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (originNode: React.ReactElement, file: UploadFile, fileList:UploadFile[], actions: {
    download: () </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    preview: () </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    remove: () </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  }) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
      </span>&lt;div className="ant-upload-list-item-container"&gt;
        &lt;div className="ant-upload-list-item ant-upload-list-item-done"&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {file.status </span>=== 'uploading' ?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
          </span>&lt;div style={{width: '100%', textAlign:'center'}}&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            文件上传中</span>&lt;Progress percent={file.percent} showInfo={<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>} size="small" strokeWidth={2}/&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ) : 
          </span>&lt;span className="ant-upload-list-item-thumbnail"&gt;
            &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">img 
              src</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{file.thumbUrl} 
              alt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{file.name} 
              className</span>="ant-upload-list-item-image"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
              loading</span>='lazy'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
              onError</span>={e =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> onImgError(e, file.thumbUrl)}
            </span>/&gt;
          &lt;/span&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
          </span>&lt;div className="ant-upload-list-item-actions"&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 预览按钮 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
            </span>&lt;a onClick={actions.preview}&gt;
              &lt;EyeOutlined /&gt;
            &lt;/a&gt;
            {<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 删除按钮 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
            </span>&lt;a onClick={actions.remove}&gt;
              &lt;DeleteOutlined /&gt;
            &lt;/a&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    );
  }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　自定义的列表项与默认的列表项在行为和样式上保持了高度的一致。</p>
<p>　　但是为 img 增加了 loading 懒加载属性。</p>
<ul>
<li>loading="lazy" 告诉浏览器，在用户滚动至图片附近时才开始加载图片。</li>
<li>loading="eager"（这是默认值）则指示浏览器在页面加载时立即加载所有图片。</li>
</ul>
<p>　　经过调试发现，300个图像请求，默认会先请求100个左右。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015153737699-1780228458.png" alt="15" width="800" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　尽管如此，还是会有小概率的情况出现图裂。</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>2）重加载一次</strong></span></p>
<p>　　为此，在图像请求错误时，增加一次重新加载的机制，而可拖动区域的小图也要加上此机制。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 预览图像发生错误时的事件 data-retried</span>
const onImgError = (e:SyntheticEvent, src:string|undefined) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    const img </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.target as HTMLImageElement;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只重新加载一次</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">img.dataset.retried) {
      img.dataset.retried </span>= 'true'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
      src </span>&amp;&amp; (img.src =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> src);
      console.error(</span>'重新加载'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, src);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h1>四、可拖动区域</h1>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015152503779-1729008971.png" alt="5" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>1）网络错误</strong></span></p>
<p>　　拖动区域的小图裂掉主要是因为上传区域的图裂了导致，两者的地址是相同的。</p>
<p>　　得到了图裂时候的错误信息。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">static.xxx.com/activity/review/1757929803424ukyomp.jpg?imageMogr2/thumbnail/!3p <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR</span> 200 (OK)</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　在客户端（你的浏览器）和服务器之间的 HTTP/2 通信过程中，发生了某种违反协议规则的事情，导致连接被中止。</p>
<p>　　查看 Chrome Net Logs （网络日志），它可以记录所有网络活动。<br>  </p>
<ol>
<li>在 Chrome 地址栏输入 chrome://net-export/。</li>
<li>点击 "Start Logging to Disk" 并保存一个文件。</li>
<li>在浏览器中复现这个错误。</li>
<li>返回 chrome://net-export/ 点击 "Stop Logging"。</li>
<li>将日志文件上传到 https://netlog-viewer.appspot.com 进行分析。搜索 ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR，可以看到更详细的错误上下文。</li>

</ol>
<p>　　上述操作完成后，并没有得到具体的错误信息，可能是日志文件还没有全部导出。</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>2）懒加载</strong></span></p>
<p>　　但是在拖动区域，也增加了 loading 属性，有时候即使组件内的预览图没有显示，此处也能正确显示。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">img </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">src</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">={item.thumbUrl} </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">loading</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">='lazy' </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015154116207-501839234.png" alt="17" width="400" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 16px">3）选中效果</span></strong></p>
<p>　　还增加了一处体验优化，即为当前预览小图增加选中效果，就是增加个 2px 的边框。</p>
<p>　　宽高也设置了一下，还用到了CSS中的 <span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)"><a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Web/CSS/object-fit" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)">object-fit</span></a></span> 属性。</p>
<ul>
<li>cover：用于被替换的内容在保持其宽高比的同时，填充元素的整个内容框。</li>
<li>contain：用于被替换的内容将被缩放，以在填充元素的内容框时保持其宽高比。</li>
</ul>
<p>　　选取关键字 cover，将图像能够等比缩放的填充满整个内容区域。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>{<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
  width</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">'100%'</span>;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
  height</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> 45</span>;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
  object-fit</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> 'cover'</span>;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
  border</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> 2px solid #a0d911</span>;
}</pre>
</div>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015154328612-551232484.png" alt="18" width="800" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1>五、预览大图</h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>1）禁止打开预览弹框</strong></span></p>
<p>　　预览弹框有一处体验优化，就是当上传组件还有文件在上传中时，禁止打开预览弹框。</p>
<p>　　避免在弹框的拖动区域，修改图像顺序时发生异常</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015154502626-2128518415.png" alt="19" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　在预览弹框中，调节大图尺寸，并且为其配置 objectFit 属性，将图像能够等比缩放的填充到内容区域。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">img 
 </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">={{ </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">width: '100%', height: '60vh', marginTop: 5, objectFit: 'contain' }} 
 src</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">='https://static.allreaday.com/xxx.jpg' 
 </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">alt</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="预览图"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015154535804-217249807.png" alt="20" width="400" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>2）loading切换</strong></span></p>
<p>　　由于在切换预览时的加载时间较长（公司网络较差），于是增加了 loading 加载的过渡动画。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015154615318-1585749201.png" alt="21" width="400" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　后续，也为大图增加了质量变换，值为 50p，确保肉眼看的时候能保持清晰度和色彩度。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">static.xxx.com/xxx.jpg?imageMogr2/thumbnail/!50p</span></pre>
</div>
<h1>六、缓存上传文件</h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>1）localStorage</strong></span></p>
<p>　　在上传按钮旁增加恢复最近数据的按钮，每次上传时会将文件列表缓存到 localStorage 中</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015154831054-1022340706.png" alt="22" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　在 Upload 组件的 onChange 事件中，增加缓存的配置，并且为上传组件增加 isCache 属性控制是否开启缓存。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const onChange = (data: UploadChangeParam) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  const { fileList } </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
  isCache &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> setUploadImageCache(fileList);
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 缓存上传文件
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> setUploadImageCache(data:UploadFile[]) {
  localStorage.setItem(</span>'upload_image'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, JSON.stringify(data));
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>2）续传失败</strong></span></p>
<p>　　本来将 uploading 也存储到了缓存中，并且在更新状态时，组件也显示了上传中的样式，但是无法续传。</p>
<p>　　可能是没有 file 对象，即没有文件信息导致无法上传。</p>
<p>　　目前就暂时无法给上传中的文件实现断点续传，所以只能先把文件名给列出来。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015154926002-1011228258.png" alt="23" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　在警告框中提供了复制按钮（用OR分隔的名称），点击复制后，找到对应的文件夹（macOS），选中搜索，</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015154945548-844303192.png" alt="24" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　将得到的查询条件复制到搜索框中，就能得到还未上传的图像。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015155002570-1005376687.png" alt="25" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>3）存储溢出</strong></span></p>
<p>　　当上传300多张图像时，页面报错了。意思就是存储超过最大阈值，localStorage 最大是 5M~10M。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>QuotaExceededError: Failed to execute 'setItem' on 'Storage': Setting the value of 'upload_image' exceeded the quota.</pre>
</div>
<p>　　尝试采用数据压缩，但仍然会报错，只能另辟蹊径。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 缓存上传文件
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> setUploadImageCache(data:UploadFile[]) {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 压缩数据</span>
  const compress =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> btoa(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(data)));
  localStorage.setItem(</span>'upload_image'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, compress);
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 读取上传文件的缓存
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getUploadImageCache() {
  const files </span>= localStorage.getItem('upload_image'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(!files) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [];
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解压数据</span>
  const uncompress =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> decodeURIComponent(atob(files));
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JSON.parse(uncompress);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>4）IndexedDB</strong></span></p>
<p>　　将数据缓存到 IndexedDB 中，理论上它可以占用 50% 的磁盘空间，所以不存在溢出的问题。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
     * 存储数据（支持大型数据）
     * @param key 键名
     * @param value 要存储的值（可为任意类型）
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    async setItem(key: string, value: any): Promise</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.db) await <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.init();
  
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Promise&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span>&gt;((resolve, reject) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        const transaction </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.db!.transaction(['largeData'], 'readwrite'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        const store </span>= transaction.objectStore('largeData'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        const item: StoredItem </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> { key, value, timestamp: Date.now() };
  
        const request: IDBRequest </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> store.put(item);
  
        request.onsuccess </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> resolve();
        request.onerror </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
          console.error(</span>'存储数据失败:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, request.error);
          reject(request.error);
        };
      });
    }
  
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
     * 获取存储的数据
     * @param key 键名
     * @returns 存储的值，若不存在则返回 null
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    async getItem(key: string): Promise</span>&lt;any&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.db) await <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.init();
  
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Promise&lt;any&gt;((resolve, reject) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        const transaction </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.db!.transaction(['largeData'], 'readonly'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        const store </span>= transaction.objectStore('largeData'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        const request: IDBRequest </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> store.get(key);
  
        request.onsuccess </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
          const result </span>= request.result as StoredItem |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> undefined;
          resolve(result </span>? result.value : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        };
  
        request.onerror </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
          console.error(</span>'获取数据失败:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, request.error);
          reject(request.error);
        };
      });
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　为了能自动清理 IndexedDB 的数据，在组件中上传文件时，触发清理的操作，下面查看占用空间的代码。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const quota =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await navigator.storage.estimate();
console.log(`已用空间: ${quota.usage} 字节`);
console.log(`总配额: ${quota.quota} 字节`);
const percentageUsed </span>= (quota.usage / quota.quota) * 100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(`已使用可用存储的 ${percentageUsed}</span>%`);</pre>
</div>
<p>　　现在即使缓存了 300 多张图像，也能实现恢复。</p>
<h1>七、上传反馈</h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>1）不友好的等待</strong></span></p>
<p>　　当需要上传几百张图时，在选好图像后，组件就会有比较长的时间没有状态变化。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015155226545-1256344880.png" alt="26" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　不给用户反馈，体验很不友好。需要在合适的时机更新上传区域的 loading 状态。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015155251661-392018115.png" alt="27" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>2）自定义上传按钮</strong></span></p>
<p>　　没有找到合适的事件，就想自定义上传按钮，然后控制按钮的点击事件，以此来更新状态。</p>
<p>　　Upload 组件只要在子元素位置增加按钮元素就能替换默认的上传按钮。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Upload </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">{...props}</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Button </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">icon</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">={&lt;UploadOutlined </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>}&gt;Click to Upload<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Button</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Upload</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　但是在 Ant Design Pro 中的 ProFormUploadButton 组件内，并不能覆盖上传按钮。</p>
<p>　　除非自定义 ProFormUploadButton 组件的逻辑，但开发成本较高。</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>3）点击事件</strong></span></p>
<p>　　首先想到的是在 ProFormUploadButton 外增加个容器元素，注册点击事件，通过冒泡的方式触发。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">onClick</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">={}</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ProFormUploadButton </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　但这样的话，点击范围会比较大，并不局限于上传按钮，而是整个区域都会冒泡触发。</p>
<p>　　然后想到的是直接给生成的 input[type=file] 控件注册点击事件。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>document.getElementById(name)?.addEventListener('click', () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  setUploadAreaLoading(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">); 
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　组件的属性 name 会渲染成 input 按钮的 id 属性。</p>
<p>　　在 onChange 事件中调用 setUploadAreaLoading(false) 取消 loading 状态。</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>4）取消文件选择</strong></span></p>
<p>　　但会有一个问题，就是在弹出的选择文件框中，不选择文件，点击取消，那么就不能触发 onChange 事件。</p>
<p>　　针对取消按钮，浏览器也没有提供专门的事件。</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/211606/202510/211606-20251015155438204-1516140806.png" alt="28" width="600" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　虽然为 window 注册 focus 事件，能够实现在点击取消时触发事件。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>window.addEventListener('focus', <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
  const fileInput </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> document.getElementById(name) as HTMLInputElement;
  console.log(fileInput </span>&amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fileInput.files)
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　但是无法准确读取 fileList 列表，当文件少的时候，fileList 会马上更新。</p>
<p>　　但是当文件几百个时，在触发 focus 事件时，fileList 仍然是空的。</p>
<p>　　而我优化的目的就是要在加载这些文件的过程中，出现 loading 过渡动画，如此就无法判断了。</p>
<p>　　为 file 控件注册 change 事件的确能马上拿到 files 列表。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>document.getElementById(name)?.addEventListener('change', (e) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  const fileInput </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.target as HTMLInputElement;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(!fileInput) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  const files </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fileInput.files;
  console.log(</span>'change'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, files);
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(files &amp;&amp; files.length &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    setUploadAreaLoading(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
  }
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> fileInput.value = '';   //清空已选文件</span>
});</pre>
</div>
<p>　　但是在 Upload 组件中，再次上传时，却无法触发 file 控件 change 事件。</p>
<p>　　即使在 Upload 组件内清空文件的值，也无法再次触发事件，很奇怪。</p>
<p>　　后面发现原来上传控件（input[type=file]）在上传完成后会被删除，之前注册的事件就没有了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">span </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ant-upload"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="reviews"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="file"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> accept</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="image/*"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> multiple</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">=""</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="display: none;"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">span</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　<span style="text-decoration: line-through">需要自定义 Upload 组件的上传区域，暂时不修改。</span></p>
<p>　　<span style="text-decoration: line-through">先与业务方同步，告知他们开启缓存的上传组件会有取消弹框无法自动移除 loading 的问题。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>5）事件委托</strong></span></p>
<p>　　既然不能指定控件绑定事件，那么可以借用委托，给容器元素注册事件。</p>
<p>　　如果用 DOM 的方式查找容器，像下面这样，那么当页面中有多个上传组件时，就会给所有的容器都注册事件。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>document.getElementsByClassName('ant-upload-select')</pre>
</div>
<p>　　而 Upload 提供了 ref，可以通过该属性注册特定组件内的容器。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const fileContainer = uploadRef.current?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.nativeElement;
const onClick </span>= (e:Event) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  const fileInput </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.target as HTMLInputElement;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 拦截非上传控件的点击事件</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(!fileInput || fileInput.id !==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  }
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
   * 在上传区域开启加载状态
   * 因为当上传几百张图时，整个界面就会卡住，不给用户反馈
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  setUploadAreaLoading(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
};
fileContainer</span>?.addEventListener('click', onClick, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>　　同样用委托的方式为 file 控件增加 change 事件，当有文件时，更新 loading 状态。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const onChange = (e:Event) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  const fileInput </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.target as HTMLInputElement;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 拦截非上传控件的点击事件</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(!fileInput || fileInput.id !==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  }
  const files </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fileInput.files;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(files &amp;&amp; files.length &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    setUploadAreaLoading(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
  }
};
fileContainer</span>?.addEventListener('change', onChange, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>　　这样就能实现在选中文件后，组件显示 loading 等待状态，取消选择框，也能关闭等待状态。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
